name: vamp
description: Live looping for Ableton Live, played from an iPad

user-facing.setup: A fresh clone to a working install: checks Node, installs every dependency, links the control surface into Live as Vamp, then runs the setup check. Safe to run again.
user-facing.dev: Mac dev: validate + cleanup + regen + concurrently(bridge, interface, browser).
user-facing.ipad: iPad setup: validate + cleanup + scripts/setup-ipad.js. Live starts at t=0; the catalog scan and Vite build are fingerprint-gated and run alongside it (FORCE=1 to rebuild regardless).
user-facing.interface: Interface only (no bridge), e.g. when bridge runs in another shell.
user-facing.shot: Headless screenshot of the interface — no Live, no bridge, no iPad. `npm run shot -- <view>`; see scripts/shot/README.md.
user-facing.shot:list: List the named views `shot` can capture.
user-facing.shot:capture: Mac-only: freeze the running set into a replayable scene JSON.
user-facing.shot:serve: Boot the mock stack and leave it up in a browser (no capture).
user-facing.shot:stop: Stop the dev server shot/tour/multitouch leave running between runs so the next one is warm (scripts/shot/stack.mjs).
user-facing.shot:tour: Capture every state of a named tour (views.mjs TOURS) in ONE boot, plus a labeled contact sheet. `npm run shot:tour -- central` shoots every central view; `-- --list`, `--only <text>`, `--full`. Drives a warm `vite dev` (left running; `npm run shot:stop`), or the last production build with `--prod`.
user-facing.multitouch: Synthetic multitouch harness — replays N concurrent CDP touch streams against the real UI on the mock stack and asserts on what reached the surface. `npm run multitouch -- --list`; see scripts/shot/README.md.
user-facing.multitouch:webkit: The same harness on Playwright's WebKit — a second engine, closer to the iPad. Runs the tap-only scenarios (WebKit has no multi-finger input: CDP is Chromium-only and page.touchscreen is tap and nothing else) and SKIPS the rest rather than reporting them green.
user-facing.validate: The setup check, which dev and ipad run first: Node, dependencies, the config, which Live opens, and whether Live has this checkout as Vamp. Fails only on what stops the app starting.

recovery.rebuild: Re-run the interface build (used while iPad preview is up).
recovery.restart-preview: Kill whatever holds :8889. It does NOT relaunch: under `npm run ipad` the preview runs inside concurrently with --restart-after 1500, which brings it straight back. (It used to try, with `pkill -f 'vite preview.*8889' && ... npm run preview`. npm runs a script via `sh -c "<whole script text>"`, so that argv contains the pattern and pkill SIGTERMed its own shell — the relaunch leg never ran, and `npm run update` chained through it.)
recovery.update: rebuild + restart-preview + status — iPad-mode hot-update sequence.

internal.lint: ESLint over interface/bridge/** — one rule, no-undef. The gate runs it inside vitest (bridgeLintGate.test.ts); see eslint.config.mjs for the narrow scope.
internal.gate: The pre-push gate by hand (scripts/gate.sh): svelte-check, vitest, both pytest suites and the production build, all at once, ~40 s.
internal.test:ax-helper: The Looping AX Helper's tests (owner/ax-helper/tests), part of the gate. Its own uv invocation because the installed helper's env is synced --no-dev and has no pytest, so `cd owner/ax-helper && pytest` is command-not-found.
internal.check:touch: Guard the pointer invariant (ADR-427): no touches[0]/changedTouches[0] anywhere in interface/src/lib, no onclick under the five performance-surface directories. The gate runs it inside vitest (touchDialects.test.ts); masks comments and strings so the components' own notes about the old dialects don't trip it.
internal.places:diff: Build every ticked Place from Live's index and from the disk scan and report every item the two disagree on (onboarding.plan.md §10). -- --all for every folder Live lists, -- --name <Place> for one. Exit 1 on a difference, 2 when the index is unreadable.
internal.generate-places: Warm the browser's Places catalog by hand. Since 2026-09-26 the interface server builds it at runtime for the Places ticked in Settings (interface/src/lib/server/places/) and serves it over /api/places/*, so dev and prep:ipad no longer run this; it prebuilds scripts/.cache/places/ and reports what the server would build. FORCE=1 rebuilds.
internal.install-ax-helper: Build, sign and load the Looping AX Helper app + LaunchAgent (ADR-439): the one process trusted with macOS Accessibility, dialed by the bridge for Reverse, Save As and similar-sound swaps. -- --status shows the agent and log tail; -- --uninstall removes app + agent. Grant Accessibility to the app once in System Settings.
internal.cleanup: Kill dev servers + clear reserved ports. Build caches are KEPT (staleness is fingerprinted) — use cleanup:caches to nuke them.
internal.setup-ipad-core: Internal: run (bridge:ipad, preview:ipad) under concurrently with infinite restart.
internal.prep:ipad: Internal: the gated Vite build (the Places catalog and the config copy left the build on 2026-09-26: the server builds the catalog at runtime, and machine values reach clients over /bridge/machine). Run once by setup-ipad.js, alongside the app launches and OUTSIDE the restart loop, so a build failure aborts instead of retrying forever.
internal.build:ipad: Internal: Vite build, skipped when the fingerprint of its inputs is unchanged (scripts/staleness.mjs).
internal.cleanup:caches: Cleanup + nuke .svelte-kit / .vite / scripts/.cache — the manual escape hatch when a stale artifact is suspected.
internal.dev:bridge:ipad: Internal: bridge with LOG_LEVEL=WARN (iPad preview mode).
internal.open:browser / open:max: macOS open(1) helpers used by `dev`. open:browser opens the page and the Live this Mac runs (scripts/open-live.js); open:max opens the Max Utility patch only while features.maxUtilityPatch is on.

scripts.dev: npm run validate && npm run cleanup && concurrently -n "BRIDGE,INTERFACE,BROWSER,MENUBAR" -c "cyan,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:bridge" "npm run dev:interface" "npm run open:browser && npm run open:max" "npm run menubar"
scripts.dev:bridge: cd interface/bridge && LOG_LEVEL=INFO LOOPING_SERVER_MODE=dev npm run dev
scripts.open:browser:
sleep 5 && echo "
🖥️  Mac: http://localhost:3000
📱 iPad: http://$(scutil --get LocalHostName 2>/dev/null).local:3000
" && open http://localhost:3000 && node scripts/open-live.js
scripts.ipad: npm run validate && npm run cleanup && node scripts/setup-ipad.js
scripts.dev:bridge:ipad: cd interface/bridge && LOG_LEVEL=WARN LOOPING_SERVER_MODE=ipad node enhanced-osc-bridge.js
scripts.rebuild: cd interface && npm run build && echo '✅ Interface rebuilt - restart preview server if needed'
scripts.update: npm run rebuild && npm run restart-preview && npm run status
scripts.bridge: cd interface/bridge && LOG_LEVEL=WARN npm run dev
scripts.interface: npm run cleanup && cd interface && npm run dev -- --port 3000 --host 0.0.0.0

author: Ben Juodvalkis
